{{Top}}
'''Skis''' were devices attached to an individual's [[Limb/Legends|feet]] for the purpose of skiing, typically a recreational activity available in multiple forms, including [[board-skiing]] and [[hover-skiing]]. Ski variations included [[Turbo-ski/Legends|turbo-skis]] and [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]]-powered [[Water/Legends|snow]] skis.
